entry.title: New: Resolution 11 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPOINTS MEMBERS OF THE POLICY COMMITTEE ON ENVIRONMENTAL AND NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT AND DESIGNATES THE CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON THEREOF

Designates Council Members Rebecca Villegas as Chairperson and Jenn Kagiwada as Vice Chairperson (remaining Council Members to serve as Members of this Committee).
